items.label: INNOVATIVE WALL ANCHORS FOR FURNITURE
items.value: Help secure furniture and valuables with TipNot Furniture Anchors. This convenient 2-pack supports up to 300 lbs and is ideal for everyday childproofing. Use throughout your home to help reduce the risk of furniture tipping.

items.label: SIMPLE CHILDPROOFING & BABYPROOFING SOLUTION
items.value: Young children love to climb, and unsecured furniture can pose a hazard. TipNot wall anchors provide added stability for dressers, bookcases, and other furniture, giving you extra peace of mind while kids are on the move.

items.label: ANTI-TIP PROTECTION FOR FURNITURE & VALUABLES
items.value: Perfect for securing TVs, TV stands, bookshelves, mirrors, and more. Whether protecting sentimental items or expensive furniture, these sturdy anchors help keep items upright with a stress-free, no-damage installation.

items.label: EASY PEEL-AND-STICK INSTALLATION
items.value: No tools, screws, or drilling required. Simply peel and stick to the wall and furniture for a clean, low-profile look that’s easy to conceal. One anchor is recommended for furniture under 36" wide; larger items may require multiple anchors.

items.label: DURABLE, HIGH-QUALITY DESIGN
items.value: Made from strong, high-quality materials for reliable everyday use. Designed for both horizontal and vertical furniture, these anchors can be removed when no longer needed, making them a practical and affordable solution for any home.
